verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's marketing says it screens customers and supports ongoing monitoring with customizable automation, so the core ongoing-screening capability is claimed. Nothing in the evidence shows a per-customer control to turn that screening on or off. The 90-day pending case review is a periodic case re-review, not customer screening, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented per-customer enable/disable of ongoing screening, selecting a subset of customers, UI/API documentation of the toggle, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can enable and disable ongoing screening for selected customers

citations.quote: Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently. Streamline your onboarding, ongoing monitoring, or ad-hoc investigations using customizable automation
